correctness.rationale: For uniformly sampled rank-r weakly isotone maps on [n], the ordered positive kernel composition λ and strictly increasing image b are uniform and independent: there are C(n−1,r−1)C(n,r) maps. An inverse β must have one image point in each α-kernel interval (∏λ choices), and its r−1 kernel cuts c_i must satisfy b_i<=c_i<b_(i+1), independently giving ∏(b_(i+1)−b_i) choices; converse crossed-transversal criterion establishes αβα=α, βαβ=β. Independent full direct computation checked all 35 maps at n=4 and all 126 at n=5 against both composition identities, not merely source claimed logs. Summing products over λ compositions and b gaps proves coefficient expression for every k>=0. Positive integer compositions converge to independent uniform Dirichlet simplex measures by Riemann-sum argument, product continuous mapping gives n^{-(2r−1)}X→Y_r in law; uniform boundedness gives all moments and simplex beta integrals yield factorial formula. Integer balancing proves sharp maximum; n=r and rank-one excluded from limit handled explicitly.
